title: 第3章 干了第4章 都是妖族同类我岂能坐视不理
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 两个月后，林野站在巨岩之上，一阵熟悉的骚臭味袭来。
他抬起头，看到了一道熟悉的身影，大约百步开外，一只红棕色的野猪正在觅食，脸上那道伤疤，林野记得清清楚楚。
之前他被这东西追得满荒原乱窜，钻进灌木丛才捡回一条命。
而现在，野猪站在上风处，尾巴僵硬地垂着，四条腿像钉在地上一样一动不敢动，那猩红眼睛里没有饥饿，没有凶戾，只有一种写在基因深处的原始恐惧。
林野动了。
身形如一道漆黑的闪电掠过荒草，妖术【裂风扑杀】自动发动，右前爪带起三道青色的风刃。
野猪刚做出转身的预备动作，三道风刃已经到了。
一道削掉了它左肩的一撮毛，一道划开它臀部的皮肉，一道正中它的侧腹，冲击力把它掀翻在地。
野猪想翻身爬起来，林野的獠牙已经落了下来。
【后嗣体质上等，你获得两年道行！】
【叮！恭喜宿主，您的第一百位幼崽降生！恭喜宿主子嗣数量达到一百，奖励妖术：敛息术。】
【敛息术：隐藏修为气息，无法被察觉。】
林野眼睛一亮，好东西啊。
系统提示音还在继续。
月夜下，他此刻的体型已经堪比巨狼，夜风吹拂，鬃毛猎猎。
【物种：野狗】
【血脉：凡兽】
【体长：八尺七寸】
【道行：九十四年】
【法术：裂风扑杀、敛息术】
【综合战力评估：我的天！生平第一次见到这么厉害的野狗，申请非遗了吗？】
林野满意的点了点头，这片荒原附近妖兽不算特别多，如此一来的话，能对他形成威胁的就不多了。
此时他的道行，已经来到了恐怖的九十四年，再有六年，就是百年道行！
届时，他就算是真正的妖了，妖、兽，一字之差，云泥之别，只有成为真正的妖，他才可以开始修炼功法。
附近的族群都被他占领了，要想增加更多的子嗣，要么等小母狗们来年发情，要么就继续扩大领地。
风险和机遇并存，可林野从来不会混吃等死。
content_en:
Two months later, Lin Ye was standing on a huge rock when a familiar stench hit him.
He raised his head and saw a familiar figure. About a hundred steps away, a reddish-brown wild boar was foraging for food. Lin Ye remembered the scar clearly on its face.
Previously, he was chased by this thing all over the wasteland, and only managed to save his life by getting into the bushes.
But now, the wild boar stood upwind, its tail hanging stiffly, its four legs as motionless as if they were nailed to the ground. There was no hunger or ferocity in its scarlet eyes, only a primitive fear written deep in its genes.
The forest was moving.
The figure was like a black lightning flashing across the grass, the magic [Splitting Wind Culling] was automatically activated, and the right front paw brought up three cyan wind blades.
Just as the wild boar made preparations to turn around, three wind blades had already arrived.
One cut off a tuft of hair on its left shoulder, another cut open the flesh of its buttocks, and one hit it right in the flank, and the impact knocked it over to the ground.
The wild boar wanted to turn over and get up, but Linye's tusks had already fallen down.
…
[The heir has a superior physique, and you will gain two years of Taoism! 】
[Ding! Congratulations, host, on the birth of your hundredth cub! Congratulations to the host for reaching one hundred offspring. The reward is the magic spell: Breath Condensation. 】
[Breath Condensation Technique: Hide the breath of cultivation and cannot be detected. 】
Lin Ye's eyes lit up, what a good thing.
The system beeps continue.
Under the moonlit night, he was now as big as a giant wolf, with his mane hunting in the night wind.
[Species: Wild Dog]
[Bloodline: Mortal Beast]
[Body length: eight feet seven inches]
[Daoxing: ninety-four years]
[Spells: Split Wind Culling, Breath Condensation Technique]
【Descendants: 127】
[Comprehensive combat strength assessment: Oh my God! This is the first time in my life that I have seen such a powerful wild dog. Have I applied for intangible cultural heritage? 】
Lin Ye nodded with satisfaction. There were not many monsters around this wasteland, so there weren't many that could pose a threat to him.
At this time, his Taoism has reached the terrifying ninety-fourth year. In six more years, it will be a hundred years of Taoism!
At that time, he will be considered a real monster. The difference between monster and beast is as different as clouds and mud. Only when he becomes a real monster can he start to practice martial arts.
The nearby tribes have been occupied by him. If he wants to add more offspring, he must either wait for the little bitches to come into heat next year, or continue to expand his territory.
Risks and opportunities coexist, but Lin Ye never waits for death.
title_en: Chapter 3 Done Chapter 4 How can I sit idly by and ignore the fact that they are all the same kind of monsters?
